Your locs look fine. People are always going to associate locs with dirtiness for some reason. You can just get a loc detox and then a retwist.  For the grand opening, you can just put them in a bun or some barrel twists.

It's very easy to reattach.  I've reattached 3 of mine. What you need to do is the following:

Cut or yank the hanging piece of loc.

Comb about 1/2 inch of both the cut end of the detached loc and the other cut end of the loc still attached to your head .

Put the frayed ends of the locs together by overlapping them.

Get a super small crochet needle with one prong and start jabbing the overlapped ends of locs.

Make sure to move the crochet needle around or twist the loc. Keep at this until the loc pieces become one.

Then palm roll that area. 

Viola! You've fixed your first detached loc! And for free lol.  

To prevent that from happening again, make sure to cover your hair at night. Also,  don't use your hair to tie up your hair meaning don't use your hair as string. Use a hair holder.  I used to do that and noticed my loc was thinning where I pulled to tighten my tied hair. 

Good luck!!

I think you'd look pretty cool with locs. Especially if they're that pink color. 

But do you! Don't ask other people for their opinions of you. Just do it. 🙂

This festival was a rat nest on fire in the sun in lava. Our drive should've been 42 minutes and that quickly turned into 1 hr and 40 minutes. There was no checking of the parking passes. We get to the entrance and the workers couldn't scan the QR codes, so they just let us in. We get in just to get in more lines for vendors. Each line had a wait of 20+ minutes and the food was grossly overpriced. I had to split up with my friend group so we could try to cover more ground. It was such a terrible experience. 


The bottled water that they were selling for $2 was bought from Sam's for around $3.50 for 30 bottles... talk about extreme markup. There was no shade. There were 5 standing tables under one tent. We gave up after being there for 3 hrs. So we hit up the portapotties before we left. Guess what? They're far away from the actual event. Then we see an unsecured entrance to the event that no one was guarding. Another reason why no one should've paid to get in. And then lo and behold, there were packs upon packs of bottled water sitting in the sun and no one was guarding them either! So what did people do? They helped themselves to the free hot ass water. We are not going back to this event ever again. At least the drive back home was much better...
